title: It's okay to not be okay (rain cloud reel, vivid)

captions.instagram:
You're allowed to not be okay. 🌧️

Feelings you hold in don't go away. They just get heavier.
Let yourself cry, rest, or talk to someone you trust.
Things grow after the rain.

Send this to someone who's always "fine".

#itsokaytonotbeokay #feelyourfeelings #selfcompassion #emotionalwellness #soundmind
